title.narrative: Promoting Conflict-affected Community Livelihoods in South Kordofan State

description.narrative: The Project aim is to improve resilience of conflict-affected communities in Habila, Dalami, Dilling and El Qoz localities of South Kordofan State. Through supporting livelihoods options for the farming and pastoral communities, improving their access to water resources, establishment and building capacities of Community Based Organizations (CBOs). With special focus on women, male and female youth organizations as the most vulnerable group to effectively engage in peace building processes, and improving community’ s access to and utilization of natural resources in an environmental friendly manner.
